question: Which of the following can degrade detritus into simpler inorganic substances?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Fungal enzymes**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Fungi, especially** saprophytic ones**, secrete enzymes that break down complex organic molecules **(such as cellulose and lignin) in detritus.**
 
• These enzymes target complex organic molecules found in detritus, such as** cellulose, hemicellulose, and lignin.**
 
• **Fungal enzymes**, particularly **cellulases**, dismantle cellulose into simpler sugars (**like glucose**).
 
• These sugars become a valuable energy source for the fungi themselves.
 
• Fungi produce lignin-modifying** enzymes (such as peroxidases and laccases)** that attack lignin’s complex structure.
 
• These enzymes **do not fully **break it down, they modify it, making it more susceptible to further degradation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Lichens: **

 
• Lichens are fascinating symbiotic organisms composed of a fungus and an alga or cyanobacterium.
 
• They can weather rocks and contribute to soil formation.

**Algae:**

 
• Algae are primarily photosynthetic organisms found in aquatic environments.
 
• They contribute to oxygen production and nutrient cycling.

**Phytoplankton:**

 
• Phytoplankton are microscopic algae that form the base of aquatic food chains.
 
• They photosynthesize and provide energy to other organisms.
